# Garg Paints & Hardware

> Wholesaler and retailer of paint additives, binders, wall textures and plastering tools in Ballabgarh, Faridabad, Haryana, India. Serving contractors, painters, dealers and builders since 2017.

## Catalogue

1. Pidicryl 126 M by Pidilite — Acrylic Binders & Emulsions — ₹130/Kg — HSN 3209
   https://gargpaintshardware.example/products/pidicryl-126-m
   Fine-particle styrene acrylic copolymer emulsion used as a binder for interior and exterior emulsion paints, distempers and texture finishes.

2. Madrasi Dana Premium Wall Textures — Wall Textures & Aggregates — HSN 3209
   https://gargpaintshardware.example/products/madrasi-dana-wall-texture
   White ₹150/Bag, Red ₹200/Bag, Peach ₹280/Bag, Grey "Contact for Price".
   Decorative granule wall texture for exterior facades and plaster-finish wall texturing.

3. Stainless Steel Plastering Trowel (Gurmala) — Plastering Tools & Hardware — ₹75/Piece — HSN 8205
   https://gargpaintshardware.example/products/stainless-steel-plastering-trowel
   Heavy-duty ergonomic stainless steel gurmala for texture application, cement flattening and wall scraping.

4. Carboxymethyl Cellulose (CMC) Powder — Industrial Binders & Thickeners — quote only — HSN 3912
   https://gargpaintshardware.example/products/cmc-powder
   White CMC: high-purity thickener for wall putty, interior distempers and smooth texture formulation.
   Yellow CMC: technical industrial grade binder for viscosity control and water retention.

5. Premium Chamki Powder (Glitter & Metallic Flakes) — Decorative Paint Additives — pack sizes quoted — HSN 3206
   https://gargpaintshardware.example/products/chamki-powder
   Glitter and metallic flake additive for wall textures, roof coatings and designer emulsions.
